The co-inventor was most likely Katharine B. Blodgett, not Irving Langmuir, which corrects my earlier guess. I still haven't checked the patent record, so this rests on the team note's description (a woman at General Electric who pioneered thin monomolecular films) matching Blodgett's known work. A Google Patents search for the title would confirm it.
CONFIDENCE: 65
